gist: a key:revocation:v1 row is never withdrawn

gist: rule 1: the producer (issuer key equals attesting_key_id) may withdraw its own row
entry_phrase: | 1 | the key that signed `T` (`T.attesting_key_id`) | none |

entry_phrase: | 2 | a key `T` names in `subject_key_ids` |

gist: rule 4: an issuer holding a valid delegates_to from any party under rules 1 to 3 may withdraw
entry_phrase: | 4 | a delegate of anyone in rules 1 to 3 |
